Container.Name: SyncSentry
Container.Overview:
SyncSentry watches rclone copy and sync jobs, mergerfs pools, and SMB/CIFS mounts on an Unraid server. The web interface shows what is mounted, what a job is transferring, what is still waiting to be copied, and the tail of rclone's logs. It can ask a host script to start a job you already defined, and it can send alerts to a self-hosted ntfy server.
It does not mount or unmount disks, and it does not write to your media. Mount the shares below read-only. A hard CIFS mount can freeze the process that asks it for free space when the network path drops; SyncSentry checks those paths in a short-lived helper and reports the mount unresponsive instead of getting stuck.
The UNAS example in the defaults is a CIFS mount at /mnt/remotes/UNASPRO_Media, reached through a Tailscale subnet route. Tailscale itself stays on the host. See the readme for the one-minute host script that records accept-routes and runs allowlisted jobs.
Not affiliated with rclone, Tailscale, or Unraid.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: rclone mergerfs cifs smb ntfy tailscale sync monitor outbox unraid

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the SyncSentry web interface.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Settings, history, data-protection keys, and trigger files. Mounted at /config.

Config.Name: User shares
Config.Description: Host user shares, read only. In the container path settings, set propagation to rslave so mergerfs mounts show up inside the container. SyncSentry does not write here.

Config.Name: Remote mounts
Config.Description: SMB/CIFS and other remote mounts, read only, propagation rslave. Example: /mnt/remotes/UNASPRO_Media. SyncSentry does not mount or unmount these.

Config.Name: rclone logs
Config.Description: Folder that contains rclone log files, read only. The seeded log path inside the container is /logs/mediamanny/initial-copy.log.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID SyncSentry runs as. It owns the appdata folder. Unraid's nobody user is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID SyncSentry runs as. Unraid's users group is 100.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for dates shown in the interface, for example America/Chicago.

Config.Name: rclone RC URL
Config.Description: Optional. URL of rclone rcd on the host, for example http://192.168.1.10:5572. Leave blank to type it in the web UI. If set, this overrides the saved URL on each start. Do not put a password in the URL.

Config.Name: rclone RC user
Config.Description: Optional user for rclone remote control. The password is entered in the web UI so it is not stored in this template.

Config.Name: ntfy server
Config.Description: Optional. Base URL of your ntfy server, for example https://ntfy.example. Leave blank to type it in the web UI. The access token is entered in the web UI and is not stored in this template.

Config.Name: ntfy topic
Config.Description: Optional ntfy topic, letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores.
